title: Month 3, Week 4 (Jan 24 – Jan 30, 2027): Cutaneous Mesenchymal, PTLD/IgG4/Clonality Pitfalls & CHECKPOINT 1 EXAM

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Spaced recall of Month 2 Soft Tissue Spindle Cell tumors.
Reading — Cutaneous Mesenchymal & Vascular Lesions (75m): WHO Skin 5th Ed. — Dermatofibroma (epidermal hyperplasia with dirty basal hyperpigmentation, peripheral collagen trapping, Factor XIIIa+, CD34-) vs. DFSP (atrophic epidermis, grenz zone, honeycomb fat infiltration, CD34+, Factor XIIIa-, COL1A1::PDGFB); Atypical Fibroxanthoma (AFX) vs. Pleomorphic Dermal Sarcoma (PDS) (diagnosis of exclusion: negative for Pan-CK/p40, SOX10/S100, Desmin, ERG/CD31; PDS has subcutis invasion, necrosis, LVI, or PNI!); Bacillary Angiomatosis (Bartonella, neutrophils + Warthin-Starry+ bacterial clumps) vs. Kaposi Sarcoma (plasma cells, hyaline globules, HHV8+).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Dermatofibroma collagen trapping, AFX, Kaposi sarcoma vs. Bacillary angiomatosis, Glomus tumor, Cutaneous angiosarcoma).
QBank (30m): 20 Cutaneous Mesenchymal & Vascular MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the 4-Stain Exclusion Panel for Pleomorphic Spindle Cell Tumor of the Sun-Damaged Scalp (Spindle SCC vs. Desmoplastic Melanoma vs. Angiosarcoma vs. AFX/PDS).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Recall AFX vs. PDS diagnostic criteria and the 4-stain scalp spindle cell exclusion panel.
Reading — Immunodeficiency LPDs, IgG4-RD & Clonality Testing (75m): WHO 5th Ed. & Curriculum Molecular Table — PTLD (Non-destructive, Polymorphous, Monomorphous, Classic Hodgkin PTLD; EBER-ISH); Methotrexate-associated EBV+ mucocutaneous ulcer (regresses when MTX is stopped!); IgG4-Related Disease (storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis, IgG4:IgG ratio >40%); & PCR B-Cell (IGH/IGK) and T-Cell (TRG/TRB) Clonality Pitfalls (Pseudoclonality in paucicellular skin biopsies; somatic hypermutation in FL/DLBCL causing false-negative IGH PCR!).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Polymorphous PTLD, EBV+ mucocutaneous ulcer, IgG4-related sialadenitis, Castleman HHV8+, Plasmablastic lymphoma CD138+/EBER+/MYC+/CD20-).
QBank (20m): 20 PTLD, IgG4-RD & Clonality MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the two major PCR Clonality Pitfalls from the SCFHS Molecular Curriculum (Pseudoclonality vs. Somatic Hypermutation false negatives).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Flash-recall Plasmablastic Lymphoma vs. Anaplastic Myeloma vs. ALK+ Large B-Cell Lymphoma vs. Primary Effusion Lymphoma.
days.b2:
Phase 1 Cumulative Slide Sprint (75m): 20 Timed Virtual Spot Slides @ 3m/case across all Phase 1 systems: 5 CNS + 5 Soft Tissue/Bone + 4 Head & Neck/Salivary + 3 Hematopathology + 3 Dermatopathology.
Review (30m): Immediate audit of missed spot diagnoses.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log any missed visual pattern from the 20-slide sprint into your SOE Log.

days.b1: Phase 1 Master One-Pager Review (90m): Active blank-sheet retrieval across all 12 One-Pagers from Month 1 (CNS, Muscle/EM, Molecular, CAP QC), Month 2 (Soft Tissue, Round Cell Sarcomas, Bone/Fibro-Osseous, Salivary/Sinonasal), and Month 3 (Small B-Cell, Aggressive B/Hodgkin/T-Cell, Melanoma/Adnexal, Blistering/Inflammatory Skin).
days.b2: Cytology Integration (30m): Review Thyroid (Bethesda), Salivary (Milan), Cervical (Bethesda), and Lymph Node (Sydney) reporting tables.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Flag your top 10 highest-yield tables for Friday's light pre-checkpoint skim.

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Write out the IgG4-Related Disease diagnostic triad and histological exclusions (granulomas, prominent neutrophilic microabscesses, necrotizing vasculitis).
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 Mixed Phase 1 + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls across CNS, Soft Tissue, Bone, H&N, Heme & Skin).
Deep Review (45m): Dissect every recall distractor.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Complete your Month 3 SOE Log entries.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m light coffee review of your SOE Log.
days.b3: Rest well for tomorrow's Phase 1 Checkpoint Exam.

days.b1:
CHECKPOINT 1 — Phase 1 Summative Mock Exam (2.5h):
• Part A — Timed Written Block (90m): 75 Timed Single-Best-Answer MCQs weighted across your front-loaded systems: CNS (15%), Soft Tissue & Bone (20%), Head & Neck/Salivary (15%), Hematopathology (20%), Dermatopathology (15%), Molecular/EM/Gen Path/CAP Quality (15%) (Target: ≥70%).
• Part B — Timed Spot & Cyto Block (60m): 20 Virtual Spot Slides @ 3m/case.
days.b2: Deep Post-Exam Audit & Error Logging (90m): Score both blocks, categorize every miss (Knowledge Gap vs. Visual Misrecognition vs. Premature Closure), and log all missed entities into your 4-Domain SOE Log.
days.b3: Phase 1 Sign-Off (30m): Re-rate all Confidence Sliders in Tab 4 (Verify CNS & Soft Tissue/Bone ≥3/5, and H&N, Heme & Skin ≥3.5/5), click Push, and switch Month dropdown to 4 - Feb 2027.
